text.tspan: America will end up taking them eventually. Right now America has
to play the diplomacy game because the ice caps haven't melted yet
but when they do, it'll be America protecting Greenland for the
Danes. It'll be America projecting force to protect EU
sovereignty. Unless the EU makes it worth it to America, they'll
eventually take it. The recent deal made that possible. Against
Danish law, America recognised Greenland as a seperate entity.
This lays the perfect framework for American-Greenland relations.
Iceland is just a floating island with no military except a tiny
coast guard. It's north side, the most undefended and least built
up part facing the future north pole sea will become one of the
most important stops for international shipping and navy's. It
can't maintain total independence. Either America takes them or
